name: Emacs Logseq Inspired Outline
description: Outliner editing inspired by Logseq and Emacs: Esc to select whole list blocks, move between blocks, wrap selections in pairs, jump to the parent block, create a sibling at the end of the level, group rows, convert block types, and a Logseq-style sidebar where Shift-clicked links stack and can be collapsed or closed.
author: 马自立
